continuity_scope: Cephalofair Games' original Gloomhaven board game, first printing, delivered to first-printing backers in early 2017. This is a board-game/campaign-system audit, not a broad Gloomhaven-world pass. It excludes later original-game printings, Gloomhaven Second Edition, the digital adaptation, Frosthaven, Jaws of the Lion, Forgotten Circles, mercenary packs, novels/other media, and player campaigns. The first printing is a distinct physical rules/component witness; later rebalancing, rulebook/scenario-book changes, and class content are not retroactively applied.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Original board game, first printing; Cephalofair reports delivery to first-printing backers in early 2017.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Official printing-history clarification; used to distinguish the original first printing from later printings and not as second-edition evidence.

coverage_rule: Terms-only board-game/campaign-system audit. The original first-printing product supplies player-selected mercenary classes, player naming/choices, sealed components, and branching scenario play rather than a bounded set of fixed named dramatic protagonists. No character or relationship records are made. Classes, races, factions, conditions, items, locations, scenarios, envelopes, campaign systems, and mechanics remain terms/dimensions. A named mercenary may be added only in a separate exact official product witness that directly profiles a stable dramatic identity; a class, miniature, personal quest, player name, or table outcome is insufficient.
omissions: All player-named mercenaries, unnamed mercenary classes, miniatures, scenario enemies/NPCs, and campaign outcomes because the first-printing rules system does not supply a bounded claim-level dramatic-character cohort in this audit.
All classes, races, factions, conditions, items, locations, scenarios, envelopes, campaign systems, and rules as character nodes.

All later original-game printings, Gloomhaven Second Edition, Gloomhaven Digital, Frosthaven, Jaws of the Lion, Forgotten Circles, mercenary packs, any novel or other adaptation, and home/player campaign continuities.
content_cautions: The game involves tactical violence, weapons, monsters, injury/death, dungeon danger, scarcity/reward systems, moral choices, and potentially dark scenario content. Groups should choose campaign content with appropriate safety and accessibility boundaries.

Sealed envelopes, unlocked components, and branching scenarios are intended spoiler-sensitive mechanisms. This audit records the system boundary but does not expose contents, plot outcomes, character identities, or puzzle solutions.
uncertainties: Cephalofair's accessible official first-printing history confirms the 2017 delivery but does not provide a single consolidated first-printing errata PDF in this restricted witness set. No unverified community errata or later printing correction is applied.

Cephalofair states later original-game printings were still printings rather than a new edition, despite updated rulebook/scenario-book/cards and balance changes. Those later changes are explicitly outside the selected first-printing witness.
A 2018 official post describes the digital product as a true port intended to retain original mechanics; it remains a separate adaptation and does not establish tabletop character or campaign facts.
evidence_basis: Cephalofair official publishing history and product documentation only. The 2017 post establishes original first-printing delivery; the official printing clarification establishes later-printing/errata/rebalancing boundaries; the official current Gloomhaven documentation identifies spoiler shields, sealed envelopes, class packs, campaign tracking, and branching-play systems but is used only to characterize those product mechanisms, not as an original-printing rules witness; and the 2018 post separates the digital adaptation. No fan wiki, spoiler database, or player campaign is used.
